name: Tropical low orbit (402 km, 35 degrees)
description: Circles low over the warm middle of the Earth and passes the tropics again and again. It never flies over the far north or south.

name: Sun-synchronous orbit (705 km, 98.2 degrees)
description: Passes over each place at the same time of day, so the sunlight in every picture matches. It reaches high latitudes but not the poles themselves.

source.title: NASA Earth Science Reference Handbook (2006)
source.detail: Key Aqua Facts, PDF p. 86; Key Landsat 7 Facts, PDF p. 188.

name: Near-polar orbit (600 km, 94 degrees)
description: Flies almost straight over the top and bottom of the Earth, so it can see the ice near both poles.
